source.timestamp_basis: received; relative to one common group origin at microsecond resolution
transformations: Subtract one common recording origin from all original received timestamps
Replace physical source identifiers with functional roles
Order by original received time and numeric original record id for equal timestamps
Retain all original numeric values and their multiplicity; no interpolation or smoothing
Keep original section gaps and measurements received after the stored section endpoint
Exclude initial snapshots, historical actions, actuator outputs and historical detector results
limitations: No independently assigned human event labels or historical input actions are included; no detection success rate is asserted.
This is an observed climate-input replay; unchanged measurements do not predict physical consequences of changed controller outputs.
The source was examined during prior inventory work and is not an untouched blind holdout.
Empty initial_state declares no preceding measurement; the first received sample of each role remains its first original measurement.
Section boundaries and unobserved gaps do not establish historical operation changes or runtime restarts.
